title: TradeStation e TradingView annunciano una collaborazione tramite API
主要内容: TradeStation Securities, Inc., a subsidiary of Monex and a multi-award-winning online trading platform, will be supported on TradingView's trading panel within a few months, with the deadline expected by the third quarter of 2019. This strategic partnership will allow TradingView users to place orders directly on the platform and benefit from TradeStation's renowned order execution. New accounts opened with TradeStation by July 31, 2019, will enjoy commission-free trading for the rest of the year.
